about: Paths the site builds at run time, for scripts/check_page.py links. Each entry is a template literal exactly as a script writes it,
and where its filled-in names come from: names (listed here), from_calls (the first string argument of each named call in the
script that uses the template), or from_glb_nodes (the node names in that model). Every expansion must be a file in the site,
and a template that isn't listed here fails the check. Anything after a ? in a template is a query and ignored.

dynamic.why: The room's and the lawn's photographed maps (js/white-rabbit-room.js photo(), js/white-rabbit-world.js tile())
The baked occlusion map for each mesh in room.glb (js/white-rabbit-scene.js); a rebuilt model with new or renamed meshes fails here until its maps ship
Per-vertex occlusion for the dense chair meshes, one byte per vertex in build order (js/white-rabbit-scene.js)
